profileRouting.evidence: Two Safari profiles connected. In each, tabs_create opened a marked tab, and tabs_create with newWindow opened a window of its own and returned that window's tab. All four tabs reached the right page by handle, followed select_tab for untargeted calls, and answered read_page and snapshot.

profileReconnect.evidence: Disabling the extension in the second profile disconnected it while the default profile stayed connected and drivable; a call naming the absent profile was refused by name. Re-enabling it reconnected the profile under the same handle, and it listed its tabs again.

permissions.evidence: The first call on an undecided site (rfc-editor.org) failed at once with permission_required and said how to allow the site from the toolbar button, which showed a "!" badge. After the user allowed the site there, the same call worked and tabs_context described the tab. Safari 27.2 shows no permission dialog.

privateByDefault.evidence: In a 42-tab profile, every tab on a site MCPSafari has not reached was listed without url or title, with access not_granted and an accessHint.
